paper_metadata.title: Applying QNLP to sentiment analysis in finance

experiments.description: Quantum-enhanced LSTM (QLSTM) sentiment classification on the low-complexity synthetic finance dataset, evaluated against a classical LSTM baseline using an 80/10/10 split.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: Trained for up to 20 epochs in the reported low-complexity run; validation accuracy over 80% achieved within about 20 epochs

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Text sentences are processed by a QLSTM; the paper does not specify a formal qubit-to-feature mapping beyond the QLSTM input vector and the three-qubit one-hot output encoding.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Binary sentiment classification on finance-related sentences

problem_instance.description: Synthetic finance sentiment dataset with short sentences generated by ChatGPT; low-complexity subset.
problem_instance.dataset_size: roughly 1000 sentences total for the dataset family; exact low-complexity subset size not specified

dataset_specification.description: Generated by ChatGPT using prompts requesting finance/stocks sentences with labels negative=0, neutral=1, positive=2; low-complexity sentences had maximum length of five words; class distribution reported as 34% negative, 18% neutral, 48% positive; average word count 4.9; vocabulary size 913; 80/10/10 train/validation/test split.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: ChatGPT-generated labeled sentences; no additional preprocessing details reported beyond dataset generation and splitting.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Training/validation curves over epochs; binary cross entropy loss; 80/10/10 split.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: ChatGPT-generated synthetic labeled sentences; train/validation/test split; hyperparameter tuning for the QLSTM architecture.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Classification accuracy and loss tracked over epochs.

convergence_data.loss_curve_shape: training and validation loss decrease over about 20 epochs

speedup_claims.caveats: The paper states the QLSTM and classical LSTM are both capable of learning the low-complexity data within about 20 epochs, but does not claim a speedup for this experiment.

experiments.description: Quantum-enhanced LSTM (QLSTM) sentiment classification on the moderate-complexity synthetic finance dataset, evaluated against a classical LSTM baseline using an 80/10/10 split.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: Training progress started to manifest only after about 100 epochs in the reported moderate-complexity run

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Text sentences are processed by a QLSTM; the paper does not specify a formal qubit-to-feature mapping beyond the QLSTM input vector and the three-qubit one-hot output encoding.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Binary sentiment classification on finance-related sentences

problem_instance.description: Synthetic finance sentiment dataset with longer, more detailed ChatGPT-generated sentences; moderate-complexity subset.
problem_instance.dataset_size: roughly 1000 sentences total for the dataset family; exact moderate-complexity subset size not specified

dataset_specification.description: Generated by ChatGPT using prompts requesting detailed finance/stocks sentences with labels negative=0, neutral=1, positive=2; moderate-complexity sentences were longer than the low-complexity set; class distribution reported as 37% negative, 17% neutral, 46% positive; average word count 18.4; vocabulary size 1608; 80/10/10 train/validation/test split.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: ChatGPT-generated labeled sentences; no additional preprocessing details reported beyond dataset generation and splitting.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Training/validation curves over epochs; binary cross entropy loss; 80/10/10 split.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: ChatGPT-generated synthetic labeled sentences; train/validation/test split; hyperparameter tuning for the QLSTM architecture.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Classification accuracy and loss tracked over epochs.
implementation_details.total_execution_time: about 10 hours for the simulation setup mentioned in the paper

convergence_data.loss_curve_shape: slow learning progress; possible barren plateau behavior

speedup_claims.caveats: The paper notes that the QLSTM training was slow on the moderate-complexity dataset and suggests possible barren plateaus; no explicit speedup claim is made.

experiments.description: DisCoCat-based quantum NLP sentiment classification on the low-complexity synthetic finance dataset, restricted to binary classification by dropping the neutral class.

algorithm.ansatz: Single-qubit Euler parameterization for words; IQP layers for multi-qubit words
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Trained for 100 epochs; only slight improvement observed over the full run

hyperparameters.iqp_structure: Hadamard on each qubit followed by parameterized controlled-Rz gates in a chain-like pattern over neighboring wires

problem_formulation.encoding_details: DisCoCat maps words to quantum states via parameterized embeddings; sentence meaning is extracted through classical postselection.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Binary sentiment classification on finance-related sentences
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Classical post-selection; wires 1 and 3 measured in the |0>^{⊗|N|} state to extract sentence meaning

problem_instance.description: Synthetic finance sentiment dataset with low-complexity sentences; neutral class removed for binary classification.
problem_instance.dataset_size: roughly 1000 sentences total for the dataset family; exact binary subset size not specified

dataset_specification.description: Generated by ChatGPT using prompts requesting finance/stocks sentences with labels negative=0, neutral=1, positive=2; low-complexity sentences had maximum length of five words; for DisCoCat, the neutral class was dropped to make the task binary.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: ChatGPT-generated labeled sentences; CCG parsing via BobCatParser; neutral class removed; no further preprocessing details reported.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Training/validation curves over 100 epochs; binary cross entropy loss; 80/10/10 split.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: ChatGPT-generated synthetic labeled sentences; CCG parsing with BobCatParser; neutral class removed for binary classification; sentence diagrams translated to quantum circuits.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Classical post-selection on wires 1 and 3; classification accuracy and loss tracked over epochs.

convergence_data.loss_curve_shape: slight improvement over time, near-random performance

speedup_claims.caveats: The paper explicitly states that the observed DisCoCat performance is barely better than random guessing and argues against generalizing this to a claim that QLSTMs outperform DisCoCat. No speedup claim is made.

complexity_analysis.wall_clock_quantum: roughly 82 hours for 100 epochs on CPU-based circuit simulation
